assumptions.allocation: Corporate NETT package only: synthetic bookkeeping allocation, not observed provider line prices or confirmed inclusions. Fractions sum to one; no additional standard services are charged again. Wedding advertised menus anchor catering only; other service charges are separately hypothetical for an unbundled generic event.
assumptions.scope_transfer: Published reference transferred into a hypothetical generic event profile; this is not a quote or booking at the named hotel.
assumptions.wedding_charge_treatment: Experimental gross-up on the generic profile, not verified taxes; tax applied to base plus service and treated as non-recoverable cost. Original menu charge scope remains unknown.
assumptions.corporate_charge_treatment: Advertised NETT reference retained without an additional gross-up. Decomposition unknown; no claim all separately added services have verified tax treatment.
assumptions.all_geometry_staffing_and_policy_numbers: Hypothetical simulator design choices, not venue measurements, legal staffing limits or empirical market statistics
assumptions.shock_origin: Bounded experimental Uniform shocks; NOT estimated from retail price variation and NOT calibrated real-world uncertainty
assumptions.forecast_escalation_policy: None. Historical retail measurements retained as contextual evidence only; no blanket CPI/seasonal multiplier applied to packages.

training.selection: fixed XGBoost settings; prior baseline; no test tuning or threshold search

authorization_scope: User explicitly requested generation of a new monetary synthetic dataset, documented unsupported assumptions, training and verification; not domain/institutional approval.
limitations: Synthetic line allocations and extra rates
Unverified advertised-rate applicability and tax scope
Shared source profiles and assumed rules; in-simulator evaluation only
